verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is published under an open license is a fair question for a hosted registrar service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Cloudflare Registrar's source code is published or openly licensed. The pack covers only pricing, DNSSEC, WHOIS redaction, the API and docs probes, none of which concern source availability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
